test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Lisa was very excited about her promotion; she was __very happy and delighted__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. on cloud nine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"on the ball"** means being alert and efficient; ready to react to any situation. (चौकस और कुशल)
 
 
• **Example: **To be successful in this competitive market, you need to be on the ball.
 
 
 
• The idiom **"on cloud nine"** refers to being extremely happy and delighted; in a state of blissful happiness. (बहुत खुश और आनंदित)
 
 
• **Example: **After receiving the job offer, she was on cloud nine for the rest of the day.
